license_interpretation: Apache-2.0 is a permissive license: the code and weights can be used in commercial and closed-source products. It asks you to keep the license text and attribution notices with redistributed copies, to mark modified files, and it grants a patent license. The upstream model code at commit 204b5e37 is vendored under libreyolo/models/neuflowv2/_vendor/ with its Apache-2.0 LICENSE; LibreYOLO's wrapper code is MIT. Upstream commits its three checkpoints (neuflow_mixed.pth as the canonical s, neuflow_sintel.pth and neuflow_things.pth as variants) to the Apache-2.0 repository with no separate weight license, so LibreYOLO mirrors them on its Hugging Face org under Apache-2.0, an implied grant from the releasing project. No gating; inference only.
